title: Detect component classes (database/api/auth_service) with subtype identity
description: Components recall is 3/519 (0.6%). Two root causes: (1) scanner under-detects components (2 for pocketbase vs 7 gold); (2) identity-key mismatch — scanner uses type:name (per-instance, e.g. asset:pocketbase-database), gold uses type:subtype (per-class, e.g. asset:database). Even detected components don't score. Gold is mostly asset:database (181), asset:api (118), asset:auth_service (109). Fix the classifier to detect these classes and fix the identity key to subtype-based (or normalize in scoring). This unblocks the flow slice (40+ route flows need detected components for endpoints). Do not change gold. Measure against pinned baseline; recall up, precision not cratered.

comments.text:
Plan-only pass complete (no code). Worktree: /tmp/scanner-2e250c-components @ faec1b3061af7ab091015ef0fb885633d7447108, branch cursor/detect-component-classes.

Summary for manager:
- Detection gap (~22 emitted / 519 gold): 8 zero-component packets; no Ruby analyzer (discourse/redmine/spree); Magento PHP patterns missing; compactAuthServiceComponents removes auth_service nodes; pattern coverage gaps for Go auth (pocketbase).
- Identity gap: componentScannerIdentityKey uses type:name; gold uses type:subtype; data-flow keys inherit name-based endpoints → flow topology fails even when components exist.
- Proposed: (1) hybrid identity at adapter emission — asset/actor → type:subtype, third_party → type:name; (2) Ruby analyzer + patterns; Magento PHP patterns; pocketbase/go auth patterns; stop/narrow auth_service compaction; (3) precision via taxonomy enforcement, section-scoped dedupe, ambiguity-safe assignment, existing metadata filters.
- Measure: materialize clones → pnpm run benchmark:scorecard → diff vs tests/fixtures/baseline/series-1-baseline-artifact.json (pinned Series 1; note: series-1-performance-baseline.json not present).
- Flow unblock: identity + asset:api synthesis unblocks ~39 Magento intra-API flows; Discourse/Redmine need Ruby detection first; many discourse route flows still needs_adjudication — partial unblock, follow-up flow slice likely.
Awaiting authorization before implementation.
